# Mood Wink launch artwork

Generated from `lib/core/branding/mood_wink.dart` using
`flutter test tooling/export_brand_assets.dart` from the repository root.
These transparent 1x/2x/3x images show the open-eyed face at 128 logical points.
The storyboard supplies the ink background; Flutter performs the wink after
the native launch screen. See `design/branding/mood-wink/README.md`.
